client.title: Build the Theme Park app
how_to: You need the original Theme Park 4.4.92 APK and its OBB folder (unzipped).
In the Theme Park project folder, run:
$ APKTOOL=tools/apktool.jar python3 tools/build_port.py <ThemePark-4.4.92.apk> <obb folder> build/ThemePark.apk http://{public_host}:{port}
Install build/ThemePark.apk on every phone. Uninstall the old EA Theme Park first.
Everyone keeps their park when you install a new build over the old one (same signing key).
